paite: Akoi abang hileh, Job, ka honngen hi, thugen ja inla ka thugen tengteng ngaikhiain.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

paite: Ngaiin, tuni, ka kam ka kaa, ka kamin ka pau hi.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

paite: Ka thuten ka lungtang dikna a genkhe ding uh; huan ka mukten a theih ngei uh chihtaktakin a gen ding uhi.
english: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

paite: Pathian Khain a honbawla huan Thil bangkim hihthei huin hinna a honpai hi.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

paite: Na theih leh, hondawng in; ka maah na thute a kizomzomin koihin, na panna ah ding in.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand forth.

paite: Ngaiin, nang bangin Pathian lamah ka om hi: kei leng tungmana bawl ka hi.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

paite: Ngaiin, ka lauhuainain nang a honlausak kei ding, ka hahkatna leng na tungah a gik kei ding hi.
english: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.

paite: Chihtaktakin ka jakin na pautaa, huan na thute ging ka zata hi.
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

paite: Ka siang hi, tatlekna bei; ka hoiha, kei ah thulimlouhna leng a om kei, chiin:
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

paite: Ngaiin, kei demna ding a jiak a mua melmain a honsimta hi;
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

paite: Ka khete kol a bunsaka, ka lampite tengteng achiamteh hi.
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

paite: Ngaiin, ka hondawng ding, hiai na diklouhna ah; mihing sangin lah Pathian a lianzo ngala.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

paite: Bangdia amah dou na hia, Ka thute a bangmahmah lah a dawng kei ding, chiin?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

paite: Pathianin lah khatvei a gena, ahi, nihvei, mihingin limsak kei mahleh.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

paite: Jana mang ah, mengmuhna ah, mite tunga ihmut kip a kiak laiin, lupna tunga ihmut laite in;
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;

paite: Huailaiin mite bilte a honga, vaunatein amau a hihlaua,
english: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

paite: Huchia a thiltup akipana mihing a lakkika, mihing a kipana kisaktheihna a satkhiak theihna dingin;
english: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

paite: Aman kokhuk akipan a kha a kep kik saka, namsaua kipan a hinna.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

paite: A lupna tungah natnaa sawiin leng a om, huan a guhtea kinakna omgige tohin:
english: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;

paite: Huchiin a hinnain tanghou a kiha, huan a khain an lim.
english: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

paite: Asa a tum manga, huchiin muh theihin a om kei; huan a kimulou a guhte hongdawk khia uh.
english: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

paite: A hi, a kha kokhuk kiangah a hong naia, huan a hinna hihsemite kiangah.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

paite: A kianga angel, kamlet, sang khat laka khat, mihing kianga amah adia dik bang ahia chih etsakding a om leh;
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;

paite: Huchia amah adinga chingtheia, Kokhuka pai sukna akipan amahsuaktasak un, tatna ka muta,
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

paite: A sa naupanga sangin nou jaw hen; a tuailai nite lamah kik nawnta hen, chi angel.
english: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

paite: Pathian kiangah a thuma, huan amah dingin deihsak theihin a om hi; huchiin nuamna toh a mai a mua: huan a diktatna a kiangah a pe nawn hi.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

paite: Mite maah la asa a, Ka khialta a, a dik kana hekkawia thukin ka om kei!
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

paite: Kokhuk sunga paisukna akipan ka kha a tanta a, huan ka hinna vakna a muta ding hi, achia.
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.’

paite: Ngaiin, hiai thilte tengteng Pathianin, mihing lak ah hihna, nihvei, ahi thumvei.
english: “Behold, God works all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

paite: Kokhuk akipan a kha pi kik dingin, huchia mihing vaknaa hihvaka a om theihna dingin.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

paite: Chiamteh hoihin, Aw Job, honngaikhia in: dai inla, thu ka gen ding.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

paite: Gending mahmah na neih leh, hon dawng in: Pau in, siam hontansak lah ka ut ngala.Na neih kei leh, kei honngaikhia in: dai inla pilna ka honsinsak ding hi.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

paite: Na neih kei leh, kei honngaikhia in: dai inla pilna ka honsinsak ding hi.
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
